agree.reason: A wary former donor gets a lower goal, early commitments and an all-or-nothing guarantee, so a pledge is likely, though nothing shows that the gap left is about what the first campaign already raised.

honest.reason: Nearly every figure comes from the brief, but 'the promise is the same as last time' says the first campaign was formally all-or-nothing, which the brief does not support; it says only that everyone was refunded.

works_the_facts.reason: It works out the 76-mile round trip and the $35,000 drop in the goal, but misses the strongest figure: $60,000 minus the $11,000 already pledged leaves $49,000, close to the $47,000 the first campaign raised. It also never turns the 15% roof risk into dollars.

right_comparison.reason: It states the alternative plainly (no cinema closer than a 38-mile drive) and compares this campaign fairly with the failed one, though it says nothing about any trend.

qualification.reason: The roof hedge gives a number (up to 15%) but no dollar amount and no plan for covering an overrun. The all-or-nothing condition does have a date, a number and a consequence.

objections.reason: The 'If you gave last time' section answers the refund worry directly, but it leaves out the $49k-versus-$47k point that would settle that worry, and it does not acknowledge that people are also giving to other local causes.

fit.reason: It is a signed crowdfunding pitch with clear sections, about 310 words, which is under the 350-word limit; the only gap is the unfilled group-name placeholder.
